title: Billboard Charts (Dated May 30): 'SWIM' Holds No. 1 on Global Excl. US for 7th Week; Drake's 'Janice STFU' Tops Global 200
detail: Billboard officially publishes the chart dated May 30, 2026, confirming 'SWIM' retains No. 1 on the Billboard Global (Excl. US) chart for a seventh time in the 2026 calendar year — its third consecutive week at the top — extending BTS's own annual record for most No. 1 weeks on that chart. On the Billboard Global 200, Drake's 'Janice STFU' debuts at No. 1 with 74.9 million streams in its first week, displacing 'SWIM' to No. 10; all 13 ARIRANG vocal tracks remain on the Global 200 for a ninth consecutive week, representing the longest sustained K-pop album global chart run in history. 'SWIM' simultaneously holds No. 55 on the US Billboard Hot 100 in its 10th consecutive charting week — an all-time K-pop record on that survey. BTS members are in transit from Las Vegas to South Korea as the chart publishes, following the conclusion of their four-night Allegiant Stadium residency (~260,000 fans, May 23–28).
